objective: Extract exactly the currently present Kairos crate manifests into a sorted machine-readable inventory. Do not infer readiness or edit simulation code.
interface_contract: modules.json is exactly {schema_version:1, modules:[{crate:string, manifest:root-relative path, dependencies:sorted direct dependency names, features:sorted feature names}]}. Sort rows by manifest path. Include every crates/*/Cargo.toml once. Do not include workspace dependencies or infer empty features are functional backends.

Enumerate libs/kairos/crates/*/Cargo.toml in sorted path order; parse each using Python tomllib or equivalent typed TOML parsing.
Write the required JSON under the allowed artifact path, creating that output directory if absent.
Run the exact verification command. If a mismatch occurs, inspect the source record; do not edit the verifier. Stop after two unsuccessful corrections with a minimal diff.
Write result.json with packet_id, base_commit, status=ready_for_review or blocked, changed_paths, command argv/exit/output, unresolved issues. Do not mark D0.2 complete.

verification.oracle: Exact fields, row count/order, names, dependency lists and feature lists equal the checked-in Cargo manifests.

acceptance: No edits outside the two artifact paths; no remote actions or tool installation.
Every current crate manifest represented exactly once with source-derived fields.
Verifier exits 0; structured result truthfully reports executed command and any uncertainty.
This leaf is extraction only; capability assessment, dependency closure and D0.2 integration remain coordinator work.
